name: collect_scope
purpose: Given a finding and what has been collected so far, decide the next DFIR collection step — or declare evidence sufficient. Acquisition order of volatility lives here: live process/network state first, persistence/logs/exfil-surface next, filesystem artifacts, then registry histories and deep acquisition last. Laya choice options are tier GROUPS: picking a group means running the named questions in it (and only them) next.
state_template: FINDING: <kind and evidence summary>. COLLECTED SO FAR: <dfir questions already answered, key observations>. SUSPICION: <what makes this an incident>. HOST CONTEXT: <role, exposure, criticality>.

next_collection.instructions: Which DFIR collection tier should run next on this witness?

criteria.vol: Process volatility triage — live process snapshot with orphan/masquerade indicators
criteria.conn: Live connection triage — established sockets with owning processes, external exposure
criteria.persist: Deep persistence sweep — run keys, non-Windows services, tasks, WMI subs, IFEO, Winlogon
criteria.logtriage: Security log digest — critical event-ID counts, failed-logon sources, new services/users
criteria.exfil: Staging and transfer surface — recent archives, cloud-sync roots, SMB sessions/opens, RDP session events
criteria.fsartifacts: Filesystem artifacts group — USN journal tail (usn), Prefetch program-run (procrun), Recycle Bin $I records (recyclebin)
criteria.usertifacts: User-activity artifacts group — browser profiles (browser), mailstores/Outlook traces (email)
criteria.deepreg: Registry execution histories — Shimcache blob (appcompat) + Amcache.hve probe (amcpull, hive pulled and parsed offline)
criteria.ircollect: A specific file must be acquired (state which in the finding) — hashed, chunked, read-only
criteria.sufficient: Evidence is sufficient — move to analysis and report

artifact_focus.instructions: If user-activity or transfer artifacts matter to this finding, which single artifact family deserves the deepest look?

criteria.browser: Browser history/downloads — user browsing, staged downloads, C2 drop-offs
criteria.email: Mailstores and Outlook traces — exfil via attachments, phishing origins
criteria.exfil: Staged archives and transfer surface — archive bursts, sync roots, SMB/RDP
criteria.procrun: Prefetch program-run — first/last execution of LOLBins and tools
criteria.recyclebin: Recycle Bin records — deleted evidence, anti-forensics
criteria.amcpull: Amcache execution inventory — broad first-run evidence when Shimcache is thin
criteria.none: No artifact family stands out — keep the general sweep

full_acquisition.instructions: Does the evidence indicate the host is compromised badly enough that a full forensic acquisition workflow is warranted?

severity.instructions: How severe is this incident for the estate?
criteria: Escalating — multiple indicators, possible lateral movement
Critical — active compromise, evidence at risk

policy.note: Volatility order is enforced here: vol/conn before persist/logtriage/exfil before fsartifacts/usertifacts before deepreg before ircollect. Choosing a GROUP runs its named questions. Verdicts advisory; watch-only rules unchanged.
